g.text: PR #2445 - Owner-approved secret deposit batches
Agents can propose new secrets without receiving general vault access.
One owner decision creates the entire batch and its reviewed sharing grants.
BEFORE
AFTER
Agent holds a user-provided credential file
CLI supports request, run and inject.
These use existing, approved credentials.
No agent deposit workflow
The owner must enter new values in Settings.
Several credentials require separate creation.
Browser-only vault management is intentional.
Restoring broad CLI credentials would weaken it.
agent-portal secret propose
stdin / file input; 1-16 secrets per batch
Encrypted staging; transcript holds only an ID.
One owner review card
Edit names/descriptions; remove recipients.
Approve verifies Portal access, then commits.
Sharing grants read/use only to displayed users.
All created, or none created
No overwrite; no agent read binding.
Recheck owner, process, rights and recipients.
Denial / ten-minute expiry clears staging.
Scope: new secrets only. Encrypted records in backups follow backup retention. Existing general vault access restrictions remain.
